event.title: A dependent team is late — do you escalate in the open?
event.description: Once senior managers are involved, the other team is held to a hard deadline. Their tech lead tells you privately that 'there will be no more informal flexibility after this'. The working atmosphere sours.

choices.action: Go to their tech lead, explain the escalation was about project risk, and try to repair the relationship
Accept the new way of working: formalise every dependency and drop the informal chasing
